# g02 – Constrained optimization problem

## Definition
- **Objective**: Minimize f(x)
- **Variables**: n = 20
- **Domain**: 0 ≤ x_i ≤ 10 for i = 1, ..., 20

## Mathematical Formulation

### Objective Function
```math
f(x) = - \left| \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{20} \cos^4(x_i) - 2 \prod_{i=1}^{20} \cos^2(x_i)}{\sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{20} i x_i^2}} \right|
```

### Constraints
```math
g_1(x) = 0.75 - \prod_{i=1}^{20} x_i \leq 0
```
```math
g_2(x) = \sum_{i=1}^{20} x_i - 7.5 \times 20 \leq 0
```

## Best Known Value
f(x*) = -0.803619
